en: A monochrome postcard view of an extensive military barracks complex set on the edge of a town with open fields and low hills in the background. Large multi‑storey brick buildings with pitched roofs and many windows are arranged around internal yards, enclosed by perimeter walls and streets. Printed German text appears at the top, identifying the place as the barracks of the 2nd Royal Saxon Jäger Battalion No. 13 in Meissen.
